data.what_the_review_fix_was: The inherited implementation accepted a subagent's startup facts whenever this instance held no consumption record of that session, so a revived/resumed child that had no record yet had its CURRENT ctx.model + getThinkingLevel recorded and shown as its startup. A reloaded session replays its conversation before the extension is re-bound, so its start reports no startup pair at all, and a pair that was never proved stays absent rather than being read off the current settings. extensions/model-cost/shared-logic/request-accounting.ts now takes the proof from the delivery alone (the record-absence heuristic is deleted); the first proved pair wins and is never rewritten.
